reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial pass of 36 original low-typing questions: reviewed every full German sentence, all four distractors, case and number, target sense, answer key, bilingual hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Two sources deferred for unsupported CEFR placement and unusual plural metadata. Bedienung restricted to device operation despite inherited restaurant example; Beihilfe restricted to financial support; Bedeutung restricted to semantic meaning. Structural CI cannot establish independent German certification, rights clearance or learner transfer. Reviews remain pending and publicationApproved=false.
